events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked into your fare for the trip in heavy rain and found no extra distance was charged. The route you were driven was 8.5 km — the same as the shortest reasonable route, with no detour segment recorded — so the higher fare came from time, not distance. The trip took 22 minutes instead of the estimated 16, and RydeTAXI fares use the taxi meter, which charges for time as well as distance. Nothing is refundable, and your account stays as it is. Thanks for flagging it.

DRIVER: We reviewed the rider's complaint about the route on your trip and found no extra distance driven. The route measured 8.5 km, matching the shortest reasonable route, with no detour segment recorded, so no refund is due. The fare came from the taxi meter's time component on the same distance — rain and slow traffic made the trip take 22 minutes against a 16-minute estimate. No action against your account, and no change to your standing. Thanks for your statement, which matched our records.
